voiceControl: Warm, confident documentary narrator. Open with urgency, then become measured and curious. Turn firmer when Lift 1 closes. Slow down for the evidence and finish calm and assured. Use natural phrasing, varied emphasis, and one clean foreground voice. Never announce paragraphs, beats, scenes, cuts, switches, or transitions. No trailer voice, whispering, singing, humming, doubled voice, or background vocalization.

beats.visualIntent: Cold open on the route problem, then reveal the SceneIndex identity.
beats.text: Traditional 3D scans can look complete while missing the instant an accessible route breaks. One lift closes, and the expected journey disappears.

beats.visualIntent: Establish the live 3D station and its semantic layer.
beats.text: SceneIndex adds persistent meaning beneath the Gaussian splat: rooms, gates, lifts, routes, and evidence that people and agents share.

beats.visualIntent: Frame the accessible-wayfinding mission and move to the gate.
beats.text: The mission: reach Platform 2 from Entrance A without stairs, while exposing uncertainty. The agent reads the camera and finds the accessible gate.

beats.visualIntent: Draw the baseline route through Lift 1.
beats.text: The first route uses the east corridor and Lift 1. It appears in the scene, where every turn stays inspectable.

beats.visualIntent: Close Lift 1 and make the failed route visible.
beats.text: Then Lift 1 closes. Its proxy turns red, its state changes, and the route fails visibly. The outage is reversible, never hidden.

beats.visualIntent: Reroute through Lift 2 and introduce the West corridor warning.
beats.text: The agent reroutes through Lift 2. The trip remains possible, but the West corridor raises a warning: wayfinding readiness is only just over half.

beats.visualIntent: Open the evidence panel and mark the weak region.
beats.text: Why? The directional sign has one oblique, low resolution view. Connectivity is known, but its text remains unverified.

beats.visualIntent: Show the two recapture recommendations, markers, and sightlines.
beats.text: SceneIndex turns doubt into fieldwork: recapture the sign front-on, then walk a reverse pass from Lift 2. Six markers make the plan concrete.

beats.visualIntent: Undo the outage and visibly return to a clean baseline.
beats.text: The person keeps control: inspect, challenge, accept, or undo. One action restores Lift 1 and the clean baseline.

beats.visualIntent: Reveal the ten-call WebMCP timeline and shared execution boundary.
beats.text: Web M C P connects to this live interface. Ten narrow tools share scene state, validation, effects, and a human-visible action timeline.

beats.visualIntent: Move from the fixture to practical applications and the public source.
beats.text: The station is synthetic, but this pattern supports accessibility review, handover, inspection, maintenance, and targeted recapture without pretending pixels know more.

beats.visualIntent: Resolve on the SceneIndex mark, tagline, public app, and source.
beats.text: SceneIndex makes a place searchable, testable, and honest about evidence. When the world changes, the route changes with it.
